title: Map-RAG: Enhancing LLM-Based Reasoning for Geo-Localization via Map-Grounded Retrieval and Self-Consistency

contributions.purpose: 把地理定位转为可审计的检索增强推理
contributions.mechanism: 三模块流水线:视觉转文本地理线索提取 + 查询 OSM/地名录的地图检索智能体 + LLM 迭代假设精化
contributions.evaluation: 消融(CVUSA)全 Map-RAG R@1 82.1%,去检索降至 68.4%
contributions.source_quote: We design a retrieval-augmented reasoning pipeline that tightly couples LLM inference with structured geographic knowledge.

contributions.mechanism: 多链自一致性校验器,按语义-地图对齐与几何可行性给多条推理轨迹打分调和
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a multi-chain self-consistency verifier to reduce hallucination and improve robustness under challenging conditions.

contributions.purpose: 实验验证准确率与可解释性
contributions.mechanism: 三公开数据集对比回归/分类/对比学习基线
contributions.evaluation: abstract 称 Recall@1 +6-12%、中位误差 -20~35%;主表 Map-RAG Top-1 最高 44.5%(Mapillary)
contributions.source_quote: Map-RAG achieves significant improvements over baselines in Recall@1 (+6-12%) and median localization error (-20-35%).

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike prior approaches that rely solely on embedding similarity or chain-of-thought prompting, Map-RAG integrates three key modules.

notes: 数据可信度重大红旗:数据集全篇不一致——abstract 与贡献段称 CVUSA/VIGOR/MSLS,但主结果 Table 5 却报 IM2GPS/YFCC100M-Geo/Mapillary,消融 Table 6 又用 CVUSA(不在 Table 5 中)。单位不一致:Mapillary 中位误差在 Table 5 为 3.2 km、Table 7 为 3.2 m。abstract 声称 +6-12% 与表内数字无法对应。疑似结果表拼凑/虚构。3 条编号贡献。
